title: ĐỀ KIỂM TRA ĐỊNH KỲ MÔN TIẾNG ANH 9 - UNIT 1: LOCAL COMMUNITY
subject: Tiếng Anh

part1.name: Phần I. Trắc nghiệm nhiều lựa chọn

questions.text: We have ________ of milk, so I need to go to the store.

I need to ________ my younger brother while my parents are out.
A ________ is someone who collects waste from houses.
A person who is skilled at making things by hand is called an ________.
They are wondering whether ________ to the craft village or not.

We should ________ our traditional customs for future generations.

part2.name: Phần II. Trắc nghiệm Đúng / Sai

questions.text: Read the following passage: 'In our local community, many artisans work hard to preserve traditional techniques. They make beautiful handicrafts like pottery and silk. It is important for young people to learn these skills so that they are not lost. We should support local products to help our community grow.'

a.text: Supporting local products helps the community grow.

b.text: It is not important for young people to learn traditional skills.

c.text: Artisans in the community are trying to preserve traditional techniques.

d.text: Handicrafts mentioned in the text include plastic toys.

questions.text: Read the following passage: 'Sorting rubbish is a simple but effective way to protect the environment. By separating plastic, paper, and food waste, we can recycle more efficiently. Many communities have started using different coloured bins to instruct people on how to sort their trash. This helps reduce the amount of waste sent to landfills.'

a.text: We should mix all types of waste together in one bin.

b.text: Coloured bins are used to instruct people on how to sort trash.

c.text: Sorting trash increases the amount of waste sent to landfills.

d.text: Sorting rubbish is a way to protect the environment.

questions.text: Read the following passage: 'When you are new to a community, it is useful to ask for advice. You can ask your neighbors where to find the best local speciality or how to get to the nearest tourist attraction. Using polite phrases like 'Do you mind...' makes communication easier and more friendly.'

a.text: You should never ask neighbors for information.

b.text: You should only ask about tourist attractions, not food.

c.text: Polite phrases make communication more friendly.

d.text: Asking for advice is useful when you are new to a community.

questions.text: Read the following passage: 'Every member of the community plays a role. Firefighters protect us from fires, while police officers ensure our safety. Electricians help maintain our power systems, and delivery persons bring goods to our doors. Each job is essential for a smooth-running community.'

a.text: Police officers are the only people who work in the community.

c.text: Delivery persons are not considered essential workers.

d.text: Firefighters are responsible for ensuring our safety from fires.

questions.text: Give the correct form of the word in brackets: Local ________ (consume) prefer buying fresh products.
Give the correct form of the word in brackets: My teacher gave me some useful ________ (advise) on how to study English.
Give the correct form of the word in brackets: These products ________ (symbol) the culture of our community.
Give the correct form of the word in brackets: We are trying to preserve our ________ (tradition) customs.
Give the correct form of the word in brackets: Please follow the ________ (instruct) on the bin to sort your trash.
Give the correct form of the word in brackets: This village is a popular tourist ________ (attract).
